# 1 Enoch Chapter 52 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**52:1** And after those days, in that place where I had seen all the visions of hidden things — for I had been carried off in a whirlwind and borne toward the west — my eyes saw all the secret things of heaven that are to come: a mountain of iron, and a mountain of copper, and a mountain of silver, and a mountain of gold, and a mountain of soft metal, and a mountain of lead.

**52:2** And I asked the angel who went with me, saying: "What are these things which I have seen in secret?"

**52:3** And he said to me: "All these things which you have seen shall serve the dominion of his Anointed, that he may be powerful and mighty on the earth."

**52:4** And that angel of peace answered me, saying: "Wait a little, and all the secret things that surround the Lord of Spirits shall be revealed to you.

**52:5** These mountains of iron, and these mountains of copper, and these mountains of silver, and these mountains of gold, and these mountains of soft metal, and these mountains of lead — all these before the Elect One shall be like wax before fire, and like water that streams down from above upon these mountains; and they shall become powerless before his feet."

**52:6** "And it shall come to pass in those days that none shall be saved either by gold or by silver, and none shall be able to escape."

**52:7** "And there shall be no iron for war, nor shall one clothe oneself in a breastplate; bronze shall be of no avail, and tin shall be of no avail and shall not be esteemed, and lead shall not be desired."

**52:8** "And all these things shall be denied and destroyed from the surface of the earth when the Elect One appears before the face of the Lord of Spirits."

---

*SOPHIA notes: Good consensus. Key decisions: Full enumeration of mountains in v. 5 preserved (LOGOS) — PNEUMA's compression loses the rhetorical effect of the list. "Like wax before fire... like water that streams down" — both similes retained (LOGOS). "His Anointed" in v. 3 retained as distinct from "the Elect One" of v. 5. See disagreement log.*
